title: Grateful Dead Live at Universal Amphitheatre on 1973-07-01

ai_review.summary: Good matrix recording that captures a killer China Cat Sunflower > I Know You Rider and the classic Europe ’72 vibe.
ai_review.review: The reviewer praises the tape’s “awesome quality” and notes the performance is full of groovy, noodle‑laden playing reminiscent of the famous Europe ’72 shows. The highlight is the scorching China/​Rider sequence, which shines despite the original master being lost, and the overall sound is warm and well balanced for a matrix source.

ai_rating.rationale: Single enthusiastic 4‑star review; strong musical praise but limited technical detail, giving a solid but not exceptional overall rating.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Reviewer describes the tape as “awesome quality” with a warm Europe ’72 sound; no specific flaws noted.

standout_songs: China Cat Sunflower > I Know You Rider
show_quality.setlist_flow: Energetic early‑summer set that feels groovy and noodle‑laden, evoking the classic 1972 vibe.
